text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) to logistics/access.py using road_status() — OPEN allows both vehicles, RESTRICTED allows only vans (light vehicles), CLOSED allows neither. P2: added passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py — filters routes_between() to routes where a truck or a van can use every road, picks min by (km, id) like best_route, returns (route, \"truck\") if a truck can use every road else (route, \"van\"), or None; best_route left unchanged. Also added rerouted_sites(network=None) listing sites in name order where passable_route's route differs from best_route's route (vehicle-only changes excluded). P3: added notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py — queues exactly one DELIVERY_MOVED text per active, sms_ok household collecting at one of the given sites, filled with the household's site and the new day, and returns the messages sent.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3"]}}
